classifications.reason: Electra officially states that Germany has no dynamic pricing, but its public pricing surface separates app, subscription and no-app/card payment and the exact current tariff must be read in the station/app context. The official page also documents an occupancy fee of 0.40 EUR/min after 80% SOC when the station is busy, with 5-minute grace and 50 EUR cap for Electra-app sessions. A historic 2025 promotional price was rejected as stale. No single exact ad-hoc amount is generalized from the mixed-locale public page without station-level confirmation.
classifications.neededToComplete: Resolve the Germany-specific current no-app/card and/or QR direct tariff for all DEELD stations from Electra station pages/endpoints and encode the conditional occupancy fee precisely.
